scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix modern
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && PUBLIC_URL=/classic npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix modern && node scripts/package-site.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix modern && npx --prefix frontend tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json && npm run build --prefix backend
